title: POST /api/p/:pid/ui-config/preset request
description: Apply a shipped UI preset (spec-004 §3, spec-005 §5; v0.3, task-060): the server writes it as `.wingfoil/ui.yaml` and commits it alone as `chore(ui): apply the <Preset> preset`. Any other value or key fails this schema: 400 `invalid-request`.
